name: Search More Hovels
summary: The Murloc hovels have revealed nothing, but you suspect the Menethil Statuette lies farther north. You continue searching for the next clue.

sections.title: Northward Search
sections.body: You believe one of the hovels to the north holds the Menethil Statuette. The search continues among the Murloc dwellings.

faq.answer: You are searching the Murloc hovels for the Menethil Statuette.

faq.q: Did these hovels have the statuette?
faq.answer: A thorough inspection of this group of hovels reveals nothing.
You believe one of the Murloc hovels to the north may hold the Menethil Statuette.
